summary: This is a documentation-only deliverable (a new docs/analysis/cost-estimate-5org-50user.md plus PROGRESS.md and ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml bookkeeping) with zero application code, schema, or route changes, so there is no architecture or security surface to assess beyond factual accuracy. I independently verified the document's most load-bearing factual claims against the live repo: src/lib/llm-client.ts's MODEL_PRICING entry for openai/gpt-oss-120b is indeed promptPer1k 0.000036 / completionPer1k 0.00018 (i.e. $0.036/$0.18 per 1M), confirming the flagged ~3.3-4x Groq pricing discrepancy; schema.ts contains exactly 431 .table( declarations as claimed; and docs/testing/PROJEXA_LOAD_TEST_RESULTS.md exists as cited. I also recomputed the per-call blended costs, scenario totals (Low/Mid/High), the premium-mix sensitivity, and the final combined $/user/month figures in sections 4, 5, and 7 by hand -- all figures are internally consistent with the stated methodology and token counts. The document appropriately labels itself a guesstimate, states an explicit confidence range, and calls out its own weakest assumptions (no real steady-state usage data, judgment-call infra sizing) rather than presenting false precision. No secrets, PII, or destructive actions are present anywhere in the diff.
